mapper.select: SELECT id,factory_name,factory_address,factory_latitude,factory_longitude,NULL AS need_id FROM factory WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT id,factory_name,factory_address,factory_latitude,factory_longitude,NULL AS need_id FROM factory WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE factory SET factory_name=#{factoryName},factory_address=#{address},factory_latitude=#{factoryLatitude},factory_longitude=#{factoryLongitude} WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE factory SET deleted_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
